description: GET /v1/capabilities (list or ?view=summary) or POST /v1/capabilities/resolve when query is set without key. query.description: Optional search string when key is empty. Hosted: always POST /v1/capabilities/resolve (keyless). Stdio: resolve when authenticated, else list filtering.
